assertions.subject: Myotonia
assertions.quote: Myotonia is a condition of prolonged muscle contraction

assertions.subject: Myotonia
assertions.quote: Myotonia is a condition of prolonged muscle contraction followed by slow muscle relaxation

assertions.subject: Myotonic muscular dystrophy type 1
assertions.quote: In myotonic muscular dystrophy type 1 (DM1), distal weakness usually accompanies myotonia

assertions.subject: DM2
assertions.quote: In DM2, proximal muscles are more affected

assertions.subject: Myotonia congenita
assertions.quote: Myotonia also occurs with myotonia congenita (a chloride channel disorder)

assertions.subject: Paramyotonia congenita
assertions.quote: Another sodium channelopathy, paramyotonia congenita, also is associated with muscle stiffness

assertions.subject: Paramyotonia congenita
assertions.quote: paramyotonia congenita is named for a paradoxical phenomenon whereby the myotonia worsens with repetitive activity

assertions.subject: Limb-girdle muscular dystrophies
assertions.quote: In many limb-girdle muscular dystrophies (and particularly the dystrophinopathies), enlarged calf muscles are typical

assertions.subject: Dysferlinopathies
